Landing.bandBody: Gym on weekdays. Kiosk on Fridays. Basement on Saturdays. We play hardcore because we have to. We play loud because the walls forgive us.

murk.bio: Screaming since he could talk. Writes the lyrics on the workshop floor.

danji.bio: Lead guitar, front row. Practices louder than the neighbors allow.

nils.bio: Bass and cable spaghetti. Holds the whole thing together when nobody's looking.

lars.bio: Drums with no brakes. Counts to four, loudly.

gary.bio: Rhythm guitar, full risk. The reason the choruses land.

Press.heading: Press Kit

We.title: We
We.storyBody: No band casting, no marketing idea. Five people who know each other from the neighborhood, standing in the same rehearsal room since {foundedYear}, with no patience for false idols.

Games.title: Arcade
Games.intro: Small games for the wait between two shows. All of it runs in your browser — nothing to install, nothing to sign up for.
Games.scoresLocalNote: High scores are stored locally in your own browser. There is no online leaderboard, and we never see your results.
Games.startHint: Space to start · Esc to pause
Games.pausedBody: Pick it back up whenever you're ready.

whack.title: Mask Smash
whack.tagline: Masks pop up. Hit them before they're gone.
whack.instructions: {seconds} seconds. Hit every mask that pops up — gold scores 10, red scores 25. Swinging at an empty hole costs you 5. It gets faster.

invaders.title: Mask Invasion
invaders.tagline: Rows of masks close in. Hold the line before they break through.
invaders.instructions: Steer with ← → or A/D, or drag with your finger. You fire automatically. Clear a row and the next one comes in faster. Three lives.

runner.title: Mask Run
runner.tagline: The mask runs on its own. You jump and duck.
runner.instructions: Space or ↑ to jump, hold ↓ to duck. On phone: tap the top to jump, hold the bottom to duck. Keeps going until you miss one.

snake.title: Mask Snake
snake.tagline: The mask leads, the tail grows. Don't bite yourself.
snake.instructions: Arrow keys or WASD to steer, swipe on phone. Eat the little masks — gold scores 10, red scores 30. A wall or your own tail ends the run.

maze.title: Mask Maze
maze.tagline: Collect every dot. Dodge the ghosts — or hunt them, if you're bold.
maze.instructions: Arrow keys or WASD, swipe on phone. Eat every dot to clear the level. A big dot makes the ghosts briefly edible. Three lives.
